card.name: Items in lists of risk factors
card.fires_on: The word "chronic" or a comma inside a list of risk factors or predisposing conditions, usually just before the final item. Typical in lists following "e.g.," or "such as" in warnings about bone loss, low potassium or low calcium.

modes.label: "chronic" before the last risk item
modes.description: The word "chronic" opens the final item after "or" in a list of osteoporosis risk factors.
modes.example: strong family history of osteoporosis, or<< chronic>> use of drugs that can reduce bone mass

modes.label: Comma inside a condition list
modes.description: A comma between conditions that predispose to low potassium or calcium.

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted tokens, which are mixed and mostly unrelated; it may favor another condition or symptom term next.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a list of risk factors where another risk condition is about to be named.
